negative_snippets: We checked out immediately seeing the rooms. Very very unclean and people have spit inside the rooms. Its complete disgusting

The Chaitanya hotel rooms are good better not furnished well. Lacks in many basic facilities.Bathrooms were not good with leaking hand shower, broken toilet covers. No chairs and poor lighting. However, manager tried to help me with change in rooms. Food was worse and kitchen staff needs to be trained to entertain guests.
Overall not a good experience

Our recent stay at THE FAB CHAITANYAS HOTEL was unfortunately one of the most disappointing hotel experiences we’ve encountered. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that the service and standards fell far short of what any traveler should expect.

The check-in process was disorganized and unwelcoming, with staff appearing indifferent and unprepared. The room itself was in poor condition—unclean surfaces, malfunctioning amenities, and a general lack of maintenance made for an uncomfortable stay. What was advertised online did not match the reality at all.

Customer service was nearly non-existent. We raised several concerns during our stay, but they were either dismissed or met with indifference. At no point did we feel heard or cared for as guests.The beds in the room were completely broken, the food quality was subpar, and it was clear that no proper maintenance was being carried out.

Based on our experience, we would not recommend this hotel to anyone.
